sentences.en: A young couple were watching the sunset from the breakwater.
sentences.zh: 一对年轻夫妇正在防浪堤上观赏日落。

sentences.en: The breakwater had no effect against the tsunami.
sentences.zh: 防浪堤对抵御海啸毫无作用。

sentences.en: The local government is planning to build a new breakwater to protect the harbor.
sentences.zh: 当地政府计划建造一个新的防浪堤来保护港口。
